title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00098 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Continued derrick inspection.
00:15 - 00:30: Performed TBT for continuing pulling 7" tubing
00:30 - 01:30: POOH with 7" tubing from 811 mmd to 739 mmd. Average pulling speed 9 jnts/hr. Needed to pull singles due to FWD PRS not operational. Lifted joints from cantilever to bay on main deck on the fly.
01:30 - 01:45: Changed dies on casing tong.
01:45 - 06:00: POOH with 7" tubing from 751 mmd to 374 mmd. L/d singles. Average pulling speed 8 jnts/hr.
06:00 - 07:00: POOH with 7" tubing from 374 mmd to 302 mmd. L/d singles. Average pulling speed 6 jnts/hr.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed handover meeting between crews.
07:15 - 07:30: Checked equipment and changed dies on casing tong.
07:30 - 08:00: POOH with 7" tubing from 302 mmd to 243 mmd. L/d singles. Average pulling speed 10 jnts/hr.
08:00 - 08:30: Casing tong not gripping. Changed dies on casing tong.
08:30 - 11:30: POOH with 7" tubing from 243 mmd to 212 mmd. L/d singles. Average pulling speed 4 jnts/hr.
11:30 - 11:45: Performed AAR with all involved personnel for pulling tubing.
11:45 - 13:15: POOH with 7" tubing from 212 mmd to surface. L/d singles. Average pulling speed 6 jnts/hr. Measured cut 4,98m below box.
13:15 - 13:45: Inspected and took pictures of cut. Protected cut and l/d joint.
13:45 - 14:00: Performed TBT prior to rigging down handling equipment.
14:00 - 15:45: R/d handling equipment. Removed c/l spool and container with clamps.
15:45 - 16:15: Cleaned and cleared drill floor
16:15 - 16:30: Performed TBT prior to p/u and RIH with combined EZSV and cutter BHA
16:30 - 17:00: P/u casing cutter. B/o taper mill and installed 6 5/8" to nc50 and nc50 to 5 1/2" FH XO.
17:00 - 17:30: P/u EZSV RT and m/u to cutter. Installed EZSV plug on RT.
17:30 - 17:45: Measured distance from bottom EZSV to casing cutter.
17:45 - 18:00: P/u single and RIH from 13,5 mmd to 21 mmd.
18:00 - 19:00: Installed power rollers behind HTS on cantilever.
19:00 - 19:30: Performed TBT prior to p/u 5 1/2" D
